description.value:
Direct hits deal +1 damage per distinct tracked debuff, capped at +3. Your DoTs gain one die step against targets with at least 2 distinct tracked debuffs, recalculated each tick; cap d12.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.
